front.title: OpenHTTPA Hierarchical Measurement Protocol (OHMP) and Transparency Log

abstract.t: This document specifies the OpenHTTPA Hierarchical Measurement Protocol (OHMP), a distributed, zero-trust attestation protocol operating over the OpenHTTPA transport layer. OHMP replaces static, manually pinned measurement configurations with a hierarchy of hardware-backed Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) Measurement Authorities. To ensure split-view resistance and cryptographic accountability, OHMP integrates OHMP-TL, an append-only binary Merkle Transparency Log requiring M-of-N multi-cloud threshold signatures.
